goyenaga.title: Architectural Portfolio & Headless CMS
goyenaga.summary: High-performance visual portfolio featuring an intuitive management dashboard for publishing architectural works.
goyenaga.description: Commercial web platform and portfolio designed for showcasing architectural projects. Integrated with a private, user-friendly admin dashboard that allows the client to independently publish new works, upload blueprints, and organize high-resolution cloud galleries in real time without writing any code.

santodex.title: Mobile Web Collectible Card Platform (PWA)
santodex.summary: Collectible card trading web app featuring virtual pack opening, collection tracking, and multi-provider secure login.
santodex.description: Mobile-first Progressive Web App built around collectible cards, digital booster pack opening, and user album management. Implements secure access using Google Sign-In and email verification code authentication. Data persistence and collection state synchronization were engineered using Supabase and PostgreSQL.

airerys.title: Commercial Portal & Automated Content Workflows
airerys.summary: Commercial website seamlessly synchronized with social media through webhooks and keyword triggers.
airerys.description: Commercial web portal developed for an HVAC contractor with a zero-friction publishing pipeline tailored for the client: the business owner simply publishes a post on Facebook containing a designated keyword, and the system (via Make.com and webhooks) automatically intercepts the content, formats it, and updates the website portfolio without requiring manual dashboard access.

cpc.client: Council for the Promotion of Competitiveness (CPC)
cpc.title: Cantonal Statistical Database & Process Automation in Azure
cpc.summary: End-to-end database schema design, legacy migration, and statistical calculation automation via Stored Procedures on SQL Server and Azure.
cpc.description: Engineered during the Supervised Professional Internship at an institution dedicated to national statistical and economic competitiveness analysis. Led the complete design and relational modeling of a Microsoft SQL Server database, migrated and validated existing datasets, and implemented complex Stored Procedures to automate statistical calculations previously done by hand in spreadsheets. The entire database architecture was deployed to Microsoft Azure.

yourfirstjob.title: yourFirstJob - Cross-Platform Mobile App & API
yourfirstjob.summary: Cross-platform mobile application (.NET MAUI) backed by a dedicated C# REST API and a relational database on Microsoft Azure.
yourfirstjob.description: Cross-platform mobile application developed with .NET MAUI to connect college students with early job opportunities. The project covered the full software lifecycle: schema design and implementation of a relational database in Microsoft SQL Server, and the development of a RESTful API in C# (.NET) to manage business workflows and job applications. Both the database and backend services were deployed to Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
